title: Portal to Paris
description: A woman in a pink and purple bikini with a headscarf stands in a sunlit bedroom, holding a smartphone and looking at the viewer. A large jagged crystalline portal in the wall reveals a starry cosmic void containing her translucent duplicate, opening onto a sunny Parisian street with cafes and the Sacré-Cœur basilica visible outside.
prompt: A beautiful woman in a shiny pink and purple bikini and ornate headscarf stands in a sunlit bedroom taking a selfie with her phone, one hand on her hip. A large broken crystalline portal in the wall reveals a starry space with her glowing duplicate inside it. Through the opening, a bright Parisian street with cafes, cobblestones and the Sacré-Cœur dome is visible. Warm sunlight streams through the window, detailed realistic rendering, vibrant colors.
